solves: Shows the image of a product, file or content in an area of fixed size, with the loading, empty and error states, so the area stays the same with or without the image.
use_when: When the screen shows the image of a product, file or content in an area of fixed size.

Choose the size by the place: sm in the table, md in the list, lg in the product item and in the upload, xl and 2xl in the side card and in the image template, media in the card, in the gallery and in the cover.
Choose the state by what happens: loading while the image has not arrived, empty when there is no image, error when it failed.
In media, choose 1:1, 4:3 or 16:9 by the fit of the card, gallery or cover.
Write an alt that describes the content, or leave it empty when the text next to it already says it all.
Use a single size per list, so the rows stay aligned.
do_not_use_when: As an icon: for a symbol use nph-icon.
As a button for an action: use nph-button.
With loading that never ends: if the image does not come, show error.
With different sizes in the same list.

size.constraint: The Figma property `tamanho`, with `mídia` as media. The default is xs, as in Figma. Reflects because the internal CSS selects the box by it. The square sizes are 24, 32, 48, 64, 96 and 128 px; media takes the content width, 256 px. A value outside the list draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

ratio.constraint: The Figma property `proporção`. Only media uses it, for a height of 256, 192 or 144 px; the other sizes are always square and ignore it, with no warning. A value outside the list draws nothing and emits console.error in development. The name is a technical proposal of P90.

src.constraint: The address of the image. The content states of the Figma `estado` are not a property: they derive from src. No src is empty; with src the piece is loading until the image loads or fails. Empty or whitespace-only counts as no src, and a new src starts the wait again. The read-only status says the state, and the host repeats the native load and error of the image, without bubbling.

alt.constraint: The accessible name, the description of the content. With text, the host takes role img and aria-label, in every state. Empty or whitespace-only, the host takes aria-hidden true. A clickable image gives it to its inner button.

interactive.constraint: The image is clickable. The piece draws an inner native button that fills the frame, takes the focus and carries the alt; the click is the native click. Hover over a loaded image shows the veil and the eye, and keyboard focus shows the ring. Without alt it renders and emits console.warn in development. The name is a technical proposal of P90.

disabled.constraint: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity. With interactive, the inner button is natively disabled: out of the Tab order, no click and no veil.

size.choose_when: sm in the table, md in the list, lg in the product item and in the upload, xl and 2xl in the side card and in the image template, media in the card, in the gallery and in the cover. xs is in the Figma set with no usage rule of its own.

ratio.choose_when: Only in media: 1:1, 4:3 or 16:9 by the fit of the card, gallery or cover.

empty.changes_for_user: No src: the frame with its border. Until the illustrations arrive, the frame shows nothing else.

loading.changes_for_user: The spinner turns at the center and the frame has no border.

loaded.changes_for_user: The image fills the frame and crops to keep its proportion; the border stays over it.

error.changes_for_user: The image did not load: the frame with its border, as empty, until the illustrations arrive. The parent explains the problem.

hover.changes_for_user: Only on a clickable, loaded image: the veil with the eye in image/on-overlay.

focus.changes_for_user: Only on keyboard focus of a clickable image: the ring in focus/ring-width, inside the frame.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole piece fades; a clickable one takes no focus and no click.

business_rules: The area is the same in every state: empty, loading, loaded and error keep the size of the frame.
The content state derives from src and the load; it is not chosen by hand.
Hover, focus and disabled exist only when the parent makes the image clickable with interactive.
Empty and error draw the frame only until their illustrations arrive; the text that explains a failure belongs to the parent.
The ratio only applies to media; every other size is square.
ai_hints: Use nph-image for the image of a product, file or content; for a person use nph-avatar, for a symbol nph-icon.
Pass src and let the piece show loading, loaded or error by itself; leave src out for empty.
Write an alt that describes the content, or leave it empty when the text next to it says it all.
Choose the size by the place and keep a single size per list; ratio only matters in media.
Set interactive only when the image opens something, such as a preview, and give it an alt; for any other action use nph-button.
Listen to the error event of the host to write the text that explains a failure next to the image.

accessibility.semantics: An image on the host, or nothing. With alt, role img and aria-label on the host; with an empty alt, aria-hidden true. A clickable image is an inner native button named by the alt, and the host has no role. The inner image has an empty alt.
accessibility.accessible_name: The alt, which describes the content. With the text next to the image saying it all, the alt stays empty.
keyboard: Tab moves the focus to a clickable image
Enter and Space click a clickable image
accessibility.focus: Only a clickable image receives focus, through its inner button: the ring image/focus-border in focus/ring-width, with the keyboard. Otherwise the piece has no tabindex and the focus belongs to the control that contains it.
accessibility.contrast: The spinner, image/foreground on image/background, and the focus ring pass 3:1 in light and dark, in every brand; nph-image.test.ts measures them until the accessibility gate of P72 arrives.
accessibility.color_alternative: Loading changes the drawing to the spinner. Empty and error will change it to their illustrations; until those arrive, the parent's text carries the difference.

invalid_combinations: A size outside xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl and media — the piece draws nothing.
A ratio outside 1:1, 4:3 and 16:9 — the piece draws nothing.
interactive without alt — the button has no name; the piece warns in development.
anti_patterns: Using the image for a person.
Using the image as an icon or as a button for an action.
Mixing sizes in the same list.
Leaving the area blank instead of showing empty or error.
